'''Keldroth''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[invasion of Belsavis]], Keldroth was part of the Imperial forces that established the [[Imperial Lodgement]] in the [[Minimum Security Section]] on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], and shared her skills with other [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lord Keldroth appears as the class trainer for the [[Sith Inquisitor]] on Belsavis in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
